title: Apple under fire for allegations of controversial business practices
summary: A CBC The National investigation into Apple's business practices, including undercover work on repair pricing and the battery slowdown scandal. It examines allegations of overpriced repairs and misdiagnosis.
why: Cited in threads on Apple repair and battery policies as evidence of questionable repair practices, rather than recommended as a must-watch.

quote.text: There was also a CBC documentary two years ago that investigated similar complaints about Apple repair practices
